record.rationale: These shared React/Tailwind control style strings are browser presentation resources extracted from the existing Writer toolbar. They have no corresponding native C++ implementation owner; they preserve the browser visual system for Writer and Calc.
responsibilities: Preserves the exact existing Writer command-button styling for both applications and provides matching text-field styling.

stackDivergence.rationale: Shared browser control styles keep Writer and Calc in one visual system.
